mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses equity discount rates and stimulates economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical data shows inverse relationship between FEDFUNDS and equity returns during low-rate periods
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment exceeding 6.0% (UNRATE > 6.0%) signals weak labor market conditions that depress corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical data shows negative correlation between UNRATE and equity returns in high-unemployment periods
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in less than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0% (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in labor market strength (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM) and housing activity (HOUST growth > 1.0% MoM) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical data shows co-movement of labor and housing markets during economic expansions
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and HOUST growth > 1.0%) fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 2.5% year-over-year growth signals high inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical data shows negative equity returns during high-inflation periods
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (INDPRO < 100) indicates weak manufacturing activity, reducing corporate profit expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical data shows negative correlation between INDPRO and equity returns
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in less than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 500 thousand units (HOUST < 500) indicates a weak housing market, signaling economic slowdown and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical data shows negative correlation between housing starts and equity returns
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in less than 55% of periods when HOUST < 500 (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate decline exceeding 0.1% MoM combined with unemployment above 6.0% (UNRATE > 6.0%) signals aggressive monetary easing to combat labor market weakness, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical data shows positive equity returns during rate cuts and high unemployment
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS decline > 0.1% and UNRATE > 6.0%) fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth below 1.0% annualized (GDPC1 growth < 1.0%) signals economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Historical data shows negative equity returns during GDP slowdowns
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in less than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth < 1.0% annualized (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).
